messages:
ellen: Heads-up — ran into a confusing state in the Playground invoke flow. When a tool call errors we show a red toast but the run-history entry stays collapsed with no inline error. Users have to click into the full trace to see what failed. Repro: call the translate tool with an invalid schema. Screenshot: https://rwd/short/snap123 :frowning: raj: Ugh, yeah that is annoying. I think the run-history row should surface a 1-line error summary and a small bell icon that opens a preview. Quick mock: ‘ToolError: invalid schema field `lang`’ and a ‘View details’ affordance. sam: Agree. Also keyboard/AX: when we expose that inline preview it needs to be focusable and announceable. Suggested attributes: ```
ToolError: ...
``` That will help screen readers hear the message when expanded. avery: Copy nits: current placeholder text in collapsed rows says "No output" which reads like success. Can we change to "No tool output — expand to see error or logs"? Short and action-oriented. mika: Would be nice to include a tiny stack snippet (first 200 chars) inline so folks can triage quickly without opening the full trace. If we include a copy button on the preview it speeds debugging. design-bot: Mock posted: https://rwd/fig/err-inline-mock — I tried a subtle red border with 12px truncated text and an overflow chevron. Also added a soft error icon to keep row height stable. Thoughts? raj: Mock looks good. Two UX tradeoffs: 1) don't make row too tall for long teams with many calls, 2) don't hide the error under hover-only interactions. Prefer explicit expand control. sam: For keyboard shortcuts, propose ‘e’ to toggle preview when a run-history row is focused, and Shift+E to expand all in that run. We should document it in the accessibility guide. avery: Copy alternatives for the inline label: - "Tool failed — expand for details" - "Error from tool — open details" - "Tool error — see logs" My vote: "Tool failed — expand for details" (clear, action first). mika: UX concern: what happens for retried calls? We should show status badges: Failed -> Retried -> Succeeded (with timestamps). The inline preview should show the most recent error and a small retry count. ellen: Good call. Also we need a graceful fallback for private deployments with limited logs — preview should show "Logs unavailable for this deployment" instead of an empty area. raj: Edge case: long JSON schema diffs in the preview. Let's render a small collapsed code block with a copy-to-clipboard button and a `Show full` link that opens the invocation inspector. design-bot: Accessibility nits in the mock: contrast on the inline chevron is a bit low at 3.8:1. I'll bump it to meet 4.5:1 for the icon and check focus ring sizes. ellen: Next steps: - Raj to spike the inline preview component and aria pattern (issue #INFER-4219) - Sam to add keyboard shortcut spec to ax-guide - Avery to update copy and make language testing checklist - Mika to sketch retry/status badge states I'll file the ticket and assign — aiming for a small MVP that surfaces 1-line error + preview + keyboard toggle. Can we aim for a dev PR by next Thursday? :calendar: raj: I'll take the spike, ETA Wed afternoon. :eyes: sam: I'll draft the AX spec and share in #eng-accessibility by Tues. avery: I'll drop copy options in the ticket and run a microtest with support team. deploy-bot: build/deploy status: playground-service:ci #3245 passed :white_check_mark: ellen: Thanks all — feel free to ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
